## Selected work

### Logic Guard — silicon that tests itself
`VLSI` · `BIST` · `DIGITAL LOGIC` · `IN PROGRESS`

Building Built-In Self-Test into dynamic logic so a chip can detect its own faults instead of depending on external test equipment. I design and analyze the logic for fault detection and reliability with my project team.

### 360° Radar — sensing in every direction
`ARDUINO` · `ULTRASONIC` · `SERVO` · `PUBLISHED`

Two ultrasonic sensors on a rotating servo scan a full circle and stream live distance data to a computer interface. The build became a published research paper on dual-sensor aerial security.
